integrity: Analytic proof and reproducible finite checker are supplied. Literature comparison is bounded, not comprehensive; no independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Real/complex finite-dimensional Hilbert spaces, equal projection rank k and dimension at least 2k; fixed squared chordal distance only. No assertion for arbitrary idempotents or lower ambient dimensions; older equivalent conditional optimization may exist.
title: Integer valleys and a sharp compatibility band for commutators of equal-rank orthogonal projections
